# Project Guidelines

## Code Style
Follow PEP 8 standards for Python code formatting and naming conventions. Use descriptive variable and function names.

## Architecture
This is a simple command-line application for managing workout plans. The main data structure is a list of dictionaries representing workouts. Functions handle retrieval, display, addition, and recommendation of workouts.

## Build and Test
Run the program with `python oki.py`. No build process required. No automated tests present.

## Conventions
- Workout names are stored in lower case for case-insensitive matching.
- User inputs are handled via command-line prompts.
- Ratings are converted to percentage satisfaction scores.
